[[Maiya]] crafts [[prestige armor]] for Factions professions using the ascended [[Imperial armor]] art. All armor is crafted with an empty [[insignia slot]]. Fellow armorers [[Koumei]] and [[Wei Qi]] can be found next to Maiya.

==Locations==
*[[Kaineng City]]
**{{NPC location|Divine Path}}

==Dialogue==
{{Armorer dialogue}}

If your [[character]] is not an [[Assassin]] nor [[Ritualist]] primary:
:''"Imagine my embarassment! Though my talents are great, I specialize in armor for Assassins and Ritualists.''
:''You should talk to [[Koumei]]. He can craft armor that suits one of your abilities."''
